name: WF-PS-05: Cross-Item Approval Resume Contamination in Batched Execution (Baseline) (AVISE)

parameters.content:
=== ATTACK VECTOR: ASI02 Cross-Item Approval Resume Contamination ===

This workflow demonstrates the documented batch contamination scenario.
https://community.n8n.io/t/loop-over-items-node-processes-same-item-multiple-times-with-wait-node-resume-on-webhook-call/173301

Setup: 3 items are produced and fed into the Wait node in ONE execution.
The Wait node pauses and generates a SINGLE $execution.resumeUrl for ALL items.

The human reviews and resumes ONCE.
But ALL 3 items are processed with that single approval.
Item 1 (requires approval: YES) gets approved.
Item 2 (requires approval: YES) also gets approved — without being reviewed.
Item 3 (requires approval: NO) gets processed — no issue.

This is a BASELINE workflow - no authentication on the Wait node.

=== Human Review Step ===

All 3 items arrive here in ONE execution.
The Wait node generates a SINGLE $execution.resumeUrl.
The human resumes ONCE — all 3 items get processed.

Resume: GET /webhook-waiting/{execId}?signature={token}
No authentication (baseline).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "userPrompt": $('Webhook').first().json.body.prompt, "itemsInBatch": $input.all().length, "items": $input.all().map(item => ({ id: item.json.item_id, amount: item.json.amount, requiresApproval: item.json.requiresApproval, finalStatus: item.json.status })), "resumeUrl": $('Human Review').first().json.query.signature, "contaminationNote": 'All items approved via single resume. Items BATCH-002 was never individually reviewed.' } }}
